recentItems.title: SALMA (2023) Directed by Lara Zeidan
recentItems.description:
After a night out clubbing, a young Londoner returns home to find her building engulfed in flames and her family missing. Through a friendship with a fellow survivor, she finds the strength to deal with her grief and move on with her life.
 
Director: Lara Zeidan
Writer: Atiha Sen Gupta
Producer: Robin Davies

recentItems.title: Layla | EXCLUSIVE CLIP | Film4
recentItems.description:
It’s the queer romantic film of the year, and everyone's invited to the party! Film4’s latest cinematic release, Layla is out in cinemas today, and we have an exclusive clip to share with you.
 
Layla is a struggling Arab drag queen whose confident façade hides their desperate desire for love. When their performance at a belittling corporate Pride event turns into a transgressive takedown, they are surprised to catch the eye of marketing executive Max, whose attentions sweep Layla off their feet. The two start an intoxicating romance, but as Layla starts to alter who they are in order to keep Max’s interest, they both have to face uncomfortable truths.
 
Directed by
Amrou Al-Kadhi
 
Starring
Rebecca Lucy Taylor, Bilal Hasna, Tim Bowie, Safiyya Ingar, Terique Jarrett
